title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics SLO context enrichment and telemetry
author: Asha Patel
description: Add SLO context enrichment to incident-bot oncall diagnostics to improve root-cause hints, runbook linking, and telemetry. This change implements an SLOContextEnricher that fetches recent SLO violation history, correlated alert context, and experiment-run metadata then attaches structured hints to oncall diagnostics summaries. Also adds new telemetry counters and histograms for enrichment latency, cache hit/miss, and runbook-link confidence. Motivation: operators need richer context in automated diagnostics to reduce mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR) and improve actionable suggestions during incidents. Changes include: enriching diagnostics payloads with SLO summaries and recent error budgets, adding a local LRU cache to avoid repetitive queries, extending runbook linker to prefer SLO-matching runbooks, and adding feature flags for gradual rollout. Testing: unit tests for enricher logic, integration test with slo-toolkit mock, end-to-end smoke tests in staging. Rollout: feature-flagged and enabled for internal oncall rotation first; monitor telemetry dashboards and SLO for enrichment latency and false-positive runbook links. Checklist: implementation, tests, docs update, telemetry dashboards, canary rollout. Links: Linear ENG-4211, SRE-872. Related PRs: pr-79024, pr-81234.
